title: Categories keeps its sort after a reload, a fresh open goes back to Name A-Z
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user who holds the "Settings - Parts" permission, on the build under test. Open Settings -> Parts -> Categories.
  2. Seed categories that exercise the sort: click New Category and create names that mix case and numbers (e.g. "Tier 2", "Tier 9", "Tier 10", "alpha", "Beta"). The Default category already exists (e.g. "Uncategorized").
custom_steps:
1. Apply a Name descending sort (or sort by the QuickBooks column).
  2. Create, edit or delete a category so the list reloads in place; read the order and arrow.
  3. Navigate away and back to Categories (a fresh open); read the order and arrow.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • When the list reloads in place, the chosen sort stays applied in the same direction and the header arrow stays where it was.
  • Opening the page afresh returns the list to name ascending, whatever sort was applied last time.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10134 (S1, Categories - sort by name); "Settings Pricing And Categories Sorting" PRD (Confluence 578781186, Locked for build 2026-09-15), Story 1; design artboards "Categories - before/after" + "The three rules that bite"; read 30 Sep 2026.
